risk_if_not_implemented: Without Antimalware Protection Mechanism Testing, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Malicious Code Protection (Antimalware)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize antimalware, or similar technologies, to detect and eradicate malicious code.
compensating_control_1.justification: Malicious Code Protection (Antimalware) (END-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Malware Protection Mechanism Testing (END-05) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Malware Protection Mechanism Testing (END-05) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
